setAssets.message: Updated active Unity MCP tool packs.

clientSurface.note: Lens emitted notifications/tools/list_changed after applying the new pack surface. If the MCP client still cannot call described tools, use Unity.Tools.Describe or helper scripts and refresh the client session.

workflowRecommendations: Use Unity.SetToolPacks before calling pack-gated tools.

setAssets.message: Unity.SetToolPacks is a host-local compatibility no-op in static_all tool surface mode.

workflowRecommendations: Call real native tools directly; no Unity.SetToolPacks step is required in static_all mode.

conclusion.promptInjectionLimit: This artifact proves what the MCP host sends to a client over tools/list. It cannot prove whether Codex injects every received tool schema into model context without a Codex-side prompt/tool-snapshot trace.
